question: Does verified capture-retention feedback alone, delivered through attack-map cue v2 (capture/quiet-conjoined attack facts, geometric pin mark), produce lasting, consequence-sensitive Stage 1 choices that transfer to unfamiliar counterfactual families, beyond matched controls?
learner: From-scratch full FlyWire graph; restrained ReversalMemory compartments plus the alpha1 reward and alpha3 aversive long-term stores on mapped KC-to-MBON edges are the only lasting memory; wiring, root IDs and signs stay fixed.
teaching: Each event binds the Fly's own all-legal ranking before feedback to an independently replayed one-reply certificate. Only the verified task outcome is delivered (protocol verified-outcome-only-v1): the informative arm's third frame carries no channel. The pinned Stockfish review cache is read only to bind each event to its panel. No teacher computes neural parameter updates.
data: Explicitly synthetic <=6-piece FEN-rooted tasks bound to verified Lichess source puzzles (first-solution capture identity); train/validation/final families are source-game disjoint and final rows stay unevaluated until checkpoint selection is frozen.
gates: Original frozen Stage 1 D1-D6, D8 thresholds (curriculum-stage-acceptance.mjs); every replica must pass. D9 (Stockfish assistance) does not apply: Stockfish teaching was set aside for Stage 1 (researcher decision 2026-10-27). Policy B (researcher, 2026-10-24): receiver causality is shown by the matched controls (D6/D8), not G0; Stage 1 D7 is deferred to the Stage 2 cumulative retention gate. From full-r15: the D4 probe sign is read from the long-term alpha-lobe valence sign(MBON14 - MBON07) (evaluator v4); the D4 threshold (>=104/128, zero incorrect) is unchanged.
deviations: Stratum labels are the classifier stratum of each board's predeclared focal capture; pin families pair a pinned board with its open counterpart, resolving an inconsistency between the 16-per-stratum quota and reversing pairs (journal 2026-10-23-babysit-stage1-end-to-end).
Receiver acceptance gates promotion, not feedback-enabled training.
Stockfish reviews use depth budgets 10 and 14: node-limited searches usually end mid-iteration with only a bound, which the exact-score rule rejects (r1 smoke failure).
Policy B: no G0 dependency; Stage 1 D7 deferred to Stage 2 (researcher decision 2026-10-24).
Input cue public-action-relative-cue-v1: the v1 absolute board cue gave two moves on one board 86% shared cells, so opposite lessons cancelled (receipts of full-r5).

ReversalMemory eta stays 0.5: the retention probe chose no eta (fix goal task 1 failed).

Revision 10+: alpha1 reward long-term store (alpha-one-memory.mjs, cue v4, brain v4, runtime factory v4): alpha/beta KC -> MBON-alpha1 edges depressed by PAM-alpha1 without DAN-alone recovery (Aso and Rubin 2016; Ichinose et al. 2015), PAM-alpha1 co-stimulated only with verified task-success pulses, readout minus mean(MBON07). Reason: restrained compartments erase a one-lesson trace within about 10 lessons at any acquiring eta (build weakness audit 2026-10-25); the Gkanias charging-to-LTM branch is not mappable on the >=5-synapse graph.

Revision 11+: aversive alpha3 long-term store (alpha-lobe-memory.mjs, brain v5, runtime factory v5; cue v4 unchanged): alpha/beta KC -> MBON-alpha3 edges depressed by PPL1-alpha3 without DAN-alone recovery (Aso and Rubin 2016; Wu et al. 2017), PPL1-alpha3 co-stimulated only with verified task-failure pulses, readout plus mean(MBON14). Reason: spaced probe v6 retained 1/4, and in every failed probe the final choice was a move punished by the board's own lessons (only the reward side had a long-term store). Approximations: no slow alpha3 acquisition or consolidation timing.

Revision 12+: attack-map cue public-attack-map-cue-v1 (runtime/brain factory v6; researcher option A, 2026-10-27): act:capture or act:quiet plus each enemy piece type that can reach the landing square after the move (pseudo-legal, pins ignored), marked when on a clear line with its own king; 20 KCs per token per pool. Engineered restricted input given to the Fly. Reason: every allowed occupancy cue was at chance on held-out training families for a perfect-memory learner (research/reports/stage1-representation-ceiling-2026-10-27).

full-r15 (2026-10-30, ledger L087-L093; agent decision under the researcher's standing permission of 2026-10-29, reversible): full-r14 with three changes. (1) Evaluator v4: D4 reads sign(MBON14 - MBON07) instead of tanh(MBON12 - MBON01). The old channel was positive on 1,412/1,412 recorded training rows, so D4 was structurally 64/128 (full-r14 audit). The new readout was chosen AFTER full-r14 failed D4, from training evidence only: 141/144 training probe signs at the selected checkpoint (naive 52/144), 24/30 on cross-family boards before their own lesson. No final or validation row informed it. (2) New replica seeds 20261111-13, so r15 is an independent replication rather than a re-scoring of the full-r14 brains. (3) CPU duty 0.75 (battery 0.25) and parallel per-replica training (runner v5); pacing does not change learning. The final families are the same pinned set; full-r14 read only their aggregate counts.
scope: Registered Stage 1 replication (full-r15) (outcome-only, attack-map cue v2): 3 computational replicas x 32 blocks, matched absent/disabled/shuffled controls, validation-only checkpoint selection, then the sealed final set and frozen D1-D8 (D7 deferred to Stage 2, D9 not applicable).
